background: Societe Generale is one of France's three largest banks, a universal bank with French retail networks, a large derivatives-driven investment bank, the Ayvens car-leasing business and banking subsidiaries in Africa and Central Europe.
synthesis: The agencies disagree on direction: Fitch upgraded the bank to A+ on 12 May 2026 and S&P holds it at A on a positive outlook, while Moody's A1 carries a negative outlook. Every ratio is weaker than the EU and Nordic peer group, with CET1 of 13.2% and leverage of 4.3% in the bottom quarter, LCR of 146% below the median and NSFR of 115% in the bottom quarter, the thinnest of the four and the one that matters most for a term deposit. None of them has moved materially over the past four periods on figures to 30 Jun 2026, so this is a settled position rather than a deteriorating one. The flagged news is positive, a raised profitability target on 21 Sep 2026 and an earlier move to a positive outlook by S&P.
